messages:
sara: Hey @kai — pushed a small follow-up to PR #412 that addresses the lint failures and shifts the merge window to avoid the morning deploy. PTAL when you have a sec. I rebased onto main and ran unit tests locally.

kai: Thanks — on it. Quick Q: did you change any test timeouts or just the merge schedule?

sara: Just the merge schedule + one tiny timeout bump in the flaky e2e: `--timeout=60` (was 30). Commit: `fix(tests): increase e2e timeout and fix lint` (abc1234)

ci-bot: CI started for branch feature/pr-412 (build 783)

morgan: small nit — in e2e/test_session.go can we rename `tmp` -> `sessionFile` for clarity? optional but helps debugging.

sara: good catch, addressed and pushed `fix(tests): rename tmp -> sessionFile` (def5678)

ci-bot: CI: All checks passed ✅ (build 784)

kai: skimmed — looks good. Left one inline comment but it's optional. Approving now. Will merge after 30m to avoid colliding with the 10:00 deploy window. :shipit:

sara: ack, thanks! I can squash on merge if you prefer.

kai: no need to squash this time, leave history. merging now.

deploy-bot: PR #412 merged into main by kai — changelog entry added.

sara: thanks all :thumbsup:
